name: ATLASZ Local Assistant
description: Explain, translate or analyse selected text and summarise the current page through YOUR local ATLASZ Control Center (127.0.0.1 only). Output is AI-generated and untrusted.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
